Natural Collagen Renewal Sculptra® & Radiesse® for Natural Collagen Renewal Advanced biostimulator injections are available on-site in Newton, MA and are performed by Elizandra “Ellie” Adams, APRN, FNP-BC, through her independent medical practice. These treatments help restore volume, improve skin firmness, and stimulate your body’s natural collagen production over time. Unlike traditional fillers that provide temporary volume, biostimulators work gradually to support long-lasting, natural-looking rejuvenation from within. These treatments are ideal for clients seeking subtle, refined results that continue to improve as collagen rebuilds—with no surgery and minimal downtime. Free Consultation What Are Biostimulators? Biostimulators are injectable treatments that activate your skin’s natural collagen-building process. As collagen production increases, skin becomes firmer, smoother, and more resilient. This makes biostimulators an excellent option for addressing volume loss, skin laxity, and texture changes related to aging. These treatments are commonly used on the: Face Neck Décolletage Hands Jawline Buttocks (non-surgical BBL for contour and skin quality improvement) Body (for contouring and skin quality improvement) Biostimulator Options Sculptra® – Gradual, Natural Volume Restoration Sculptra® is a collagen-stimulating injectable that works over time to restore facial volume, improve skin quality, and strengthen the skin’s structure. Rather than providing instant volume, Sculptra helps your body rebuild its own collagen, resulting in subtle, natural-looking improvements that develop gradually over several weeks. Sculptra is commonly used for: Facial volume loss Fine lines and wrinkles Neck and décolletage rejuvenation Hand rejuvenation Skin firmness and texture Non-surgical body contouring treatments 👉 Learn more on our dedicated Sculptra page Radiesse® – Immediate Support with Long-Term Collagen Stimulation Radiesse® provides both immediate structural support and long-term collagen stimulation. It is often used for facial contouring, jawline definition, and hand rejuvenation. When diluted (hyperdilute Radiesse), it can also improve skin laxity and texture in areas such as the neck and chest. Radiesse® is a great option for: Jawline definition Lower face support Hand rejuvenation Skin tightening Texture improvement All Biostimulator treatments are provided exclusively under Ellie Adams' independent medical practice. Who Is a Good Candidate for Biostimulators? You may be a good candidate if you: Are experiencing volume loss or skin laxity. Want natural-looking, gradual results. Prefer collagen-stimulating treatments over traditional fillers. Are looking for long-lasting rejuvenation without surgery. A consultation is the best way to determine which biostimulator is right for you. What to Expect During Treatment Treatment time: 20–30 minutes Minimal discomfort No downtime Gradual improvement over weeks to months Results that continue to improve as collagen builds Biostimulator Aftercare Avoid heavy exercise for 24 hours. Do not massage treated areas unless instructed. Avoid excessive heat for 48 hours. Follow provider-specific aftercare instructions.
